description: This file defines the TailscaleService class responsible for managing Tailscale VPN integration within a macOS application. It includes methods for checking the Tailscale application's installation status, fetching and parsing Tailscale status via API, and providing UI actions to open Tailscale-related URLs. The class maintains internal state about the Tailscale service's current status and exposes it for use in the app.

classes.name: TailscaleService
classes.description: A singleton service class managing Tailscale VPN status, installation checks, and providing actions for opening Tailscale-related URLs. It maintains internal state variables about Tailscale's connectivity and status.

methods.name: checkAppInstallation
methods.description: Checks if the Tailscale application is installed on the system by verifying the presence of /Applications/Tailscale.app.

methods.name: fetchTailscaleStatus
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous network request to retrieve the current Tailscale status from the local API endpoint, parsing the JSON response.

methods.name: checkTailscaleStatus
methods.description: Main method to update internal status variables based on app installation, fetch results, and fallback detection, also triggers refresh if IP changes.

methods.name: openTailscaleApp
methods.description: Opens the Tailscale application via NSWorkspace.

methods.name: openAppStore
methods.description: Opens the Tailscale app store page.

methods.name: openSetupGuide
methods.description: Opens the Tailscale setup/update guide webpage.
